rfp.subject: RFP: leadership offsite 2027-06-02, 18 guests, 2 nights
rfp.body:
Hello,

We are planning a leadership offsite and would like a proposal.

Dates: arrival 2027-06-02, departure 2027-06-04 (2 nights).
Guests: 18, in single-occupancy rooms (36 room nights).
Meeting space: one plenary meeting room for 18 for both days. We have not asked for breakout rooms, but please say what you can offer.
Catering: lunch and coffee breaks on meeting days.
Dietary: 3 vegan, 2 gluten-free.
Accessibility: 1 wheelchair user. We need a step-free route, an accessible bedroom and an accessible bathroom.
Budget: up to EUR 12,000 in total.

Please send your price, any other open dates in the week from 2027-06-02, and your terms by 2026-11-06.

Thank you,
Demo Co.
